LAW AND MOTION 301, ARGUED AND THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS -- PETITIONER LAUREL NICHINSON'S NOTICE OF HEARING ON PETITION FOR WRIT OF MANDATE IS DENIED. THE WEIGHT OF THE EVIDENCE SUPPORTS THE CONCLUSION THAT PLAINTIFF WAS ADVISED OF THE CONSEQUENCES OF NOT CONSENTING TO A BLOOD DRIVE BUT NONETHELESS REFUSED TO DO SO. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189
